crime.value: Deliberate substitution of astronaut's food supply with empty containers before Mars launch; method: chemist Dr. Anders removed nutritional concentrates and replaced them with inert pellets; central question: will the sabotage be discovered before launch, or will the astronaut die in space?
crime.quote: was this supposed to have been in the ship?... You mean he's off in space to starve to death?

victim.value: Captain Miguel Randazzo, the astronaut—'The Perfect Human'—targeted because he seduced Dr. Anders' wife Olga during the pre-launch period, making him killable through intimate betrayal and the perfect cover of a space mission.
victim.quote: What woman could resist the appeal of such a man, a man soon to vanish on a hero's mission into the sky, perhaps never to return!

closed_world.value: International space launch facility with heavily guarded perimeter, restricted access zones, and continuous surveillance of all personnel; countdown creates temporal closure—once launch begins, the crime cannot be stopped or reversed.
closed_world.quote: everyone connected with the Project, from the Director down to the restaurant bus-boys, had been rigorously investigated and kept under observation

culprit_and_motive.value: Dr. Max Anders, a chemist on the project team; motive: revenge for Randazzo's seduction of his wife Olga. He substitutes the food supply knowing Randazzo will slowly starve during the three-month round trip to Mars.
culprit_and_motive.quote: Dr. Anders merely repeated, in his calm and even tones, the phrase he had just used: 'He needn't starve.'

resolution.value: Incomplete resolution. Security Officer Farquhar discovers the empty food containers cascading from the cupboard moments after launch, deduces Anders' sabotage from scattered pellets, and confronts him. However, the rocket is already in space and cannot be recalled; the crime succeeds. No restoration of order occurs.
resolution.quote: By the dozens, tiny pellets came cascading out... Farquhar turned around, conscious... of the loudspeaker voice that crackled now above the roar with a piercing excitement

investigator.value: Security Officer Farquhar, an institutional detective with access to surveillance files and dossiers; he observes suspicious behavioral cues (Whitby's tortured expression, Mrs. Whitby's rigid grief) and pursues the investigation through interrogation, deduction, and phone verification until the moment of irreversible launch.
investigator.quote: Security Officer Farquhar leaned against the east wall of the Commissary, his thoughts uneasily revolving around the thousand possibilities for trouble.
